page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9t.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by Intel Xeon 8575C processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores with a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz and a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring no hyperthreading overhead. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance integrates eight G59 GPUs delivering a combined 256 GB of VRAM. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 170 Gbps. However, the instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options.

This hardware profile is designed for massive parallel processing tasks, including large-scale machine learning, GPU-accelerated data science, and complex simulation workloads. The high resource density of dedicated CPU cores, substantial system memory, and multiple GPUs offers a consolidated platform for heavy enterprise workloads, though the lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for data-intensive I/O.
